domain: For an original vocabulary of V classes the learned coordinates are a probability table over the 2V-1 latent states of the cyclic group, one row per ordered pair of input tokens, with equal probabilities on opposite latent states and with operator and nuclear norms at most the input side N on every nonconstant Fourier moment of the latent table (CM16, Lean 3447d663); the constant moment of probability rows is the all-ones matrix, whose two norms are N (CM13). The fixed fold decoder sends the latent states c and -c to the original class c in the given class order; it is determined by V alone, reads no training label and no input token, and is not learned. The input side N, the 2V-1 latent states and the V output classes are separate sizes in the code; these tasks have N = V = 97 and 193 latent states. Input tokens are used as table indices only. No arithmetic function of token values is supplied, and no output class is removed from the softmax.
solver: Uniform initial latent table. Each update applies one row projection onto even probability vectors and one projection of every cosine moment onto the two spectral budgets, with the splitting of the CM5 solver at unit step. Full and mini minimize ordinary cross-entropy of the decoded probabilities, used as logits at scale one over all V classes; the latent gradient is the class gradient read through the decoder. Mini keeps the original incremental aggregated gradients, shuffle seed, batch size and tails. Forward only confines each observed row to the fiber of its label and evaluates no derivative. Batch size and observation cadence are those of the original suite row; update caps are those of the CM12 cohort. At each scheduled observation the shadow table is mixed with the uniform latent table until both budgets hold; a positive-update observation within 1e-8 of the common CE lower bound stops the cell, otherwise the cap does. No convergence of these iterations is proved or claimed.
comparison: All 24 cells are evaluated once and all are retained, including cells that stop at the cap, with every original split metric and every cost. The standalone summary selects nothing. The integration step requires the complete unchanged decoded-phase cohort, whose summary retains every earlier candidate. For each of its 24 choices it orders [paired candidate of the same task and training mode, earlier selection] and takes the first within 1e-8 of the common full-vocabulary training-CE lower bound, otherwise the lower training CE. The earlier choice is retained whole even if accuracy regresses. No held-out metric chooses a candidate, stops a run or sets a budget. The unchanged original rule reports a pass at 99% exact sequences on the primary split and on every held-out split. This adaptive eight-task follow-up is not a full35 result and not a fresh transformer comparison.
provenance: Before this freeze the solver was run only on a three-by-three fixture and on a synthetic random-phase fold table of the original sizes; no update was computed on the original data, which the tests read for sizes and schedule alone. Replay restores each saved splitting point, reproduces the saved latent and decoded tables exactly, and rechecks schedule, exposure and cost records. An independent raw audit then reflects the saved half table to all 2V-1 latent states, recomputes the decoded table, the Fourier matrix of each of the 2V-2 nonconstant frequencies by direct complex sums before a shared LAPACK SVD, the full-vocabulary CE and every original split metric. Every replay seal and model, state and result digest is verified before the summary. The floating-point spectral checks are not interval or exact-real certificates.
resource_policy: Training and replay are strictly serial under an 8 GiB address-space cap with single-thread BLAS. The three sizes are validated and an explicit buffer bound is checked against 2 GiB before any numerical buffer is allocated. A 16 GiB disk reserve is kept. JSON writes are streamed and JSON reads are bounded. An existing cohort is never overwritten, an interrupted cell is never resumed, and no planned cell is dropped. Generated models, logs and reports stay ignored and local.
